comparison.objective: Adjust a wrench snugly onto a nut, loosen the nut, then remove and set down the wrench.
comparison.physical_skill: Jaw adjustment on flats, force-controlled wrench pulling, regrasping, and tool removal.
comparison.success_condition: Required counterclockwise rotation must occur without loose-jaw corner loading; the wrench must finish clear and set down.
comparison.reason: Adjustable-wrench use tests fit adjustment and torque without rounding, not dual-blade latch depression and axial terminal removal.
